item.title: Rand Morgue, FNM Davis Critique, Fenty Foundation

item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, we bring you the latest details after another alarming dog attack in Grand Bahama leaves an eleven-year-old boy hospitalized. Health officials provide a major update on the construction timeline for the long-delayed Rand Memorial Hospital morgue, while the opposition chairman issues a scathing critique of the government's performance. We also honor the legacy of beloved Bahamian artist Stefan "Legend" Davis as tributes pour in following a tragic South Florida accident, and we follow young local surfers making history on the global stage. Be sure to tune in for these headlines, a firsthand look at a major new beauty launch in the capital, and your complete sports and weather updates.
